thesis.primaryProblem: A useful specialist website is difficult to understand because its purpose, audience and next action are spread across unrelated pages.
thesis.primaryAudience: Owners and maintainers of focused public websites.
thesis.usefulOutcome: Make the site communicate one primary problem boundary, a small set of problem lanes and a clear next action.
thesis.distinctEvidence: Real examples, source-backed guidance, implementation receipts and outcome measurements kept separate from claims.
thesis.primaryAction: Review the site focus contract and choose one bounded improvement.

problemLanes.label: Decide
problemLanes.job: Understand what the site should own and what should stay out.
problemLanes.audience: A site owner deciding what to publish.
problemLanes.problem: The site is trying to cover too many unrelated intents without a clear product boundary.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: Choose a small explicit set of problems the site will solve.

problemLanes.label: Improve
problemLanes.job: Turn the chosen scope into concrete page and navigation changes.
problemLanes.audience: A maintainer who can change the site.
problemLanes.problem: The current homepage and navigation do not reflect the intended problem structure.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: Create a clearer homepage, page hierarchy and navigation contract.

problemLanes.label: Prove
problemLanes.job: Verify implementation and keep later outcome evidence separate.
problemLanes.audience: A maintainer reviewing whether a change actually helped.
problemLanes.problem: Implementation success is often confused with ranking, citation or conversion impact.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: Preserve implementation evidence and later field outcomes as separate observations.

visualPrinciples: Bright high-contrast identity without decorative clutter.
Strong typographic hierarchy with evidence-led diagrams.
Dense technical detail progressively disclosed after a simple first screen.

notes: The performance values are budgets that require real field evidence; the static focus audit does not fabricate Core Web Vitals measurements.
Visual principles are design intent, not an automated beauty score.
